experiment: Zero-.package Sim Pie-Menu injection via runtime ImmediateSuperInteraction subclassing and Zone.on_loading_screen_animation_finished

subclass_overrides: cheat = False, debug = False, simless = False, allow_user_directed = True
category = None (top-level Pie Menu slice), pie_menu_priority = 30 (maximum EP14 priority)
_get_name(cls, inst, ...) -> "Enable English Banter" / "Disable English Banter" on active Sim; "Speak to <FirstName> (English)..." on other Sims
_run_interaction_gen(self, timeline) -> toggles start_ai("outcome") / stop() on self-click, or opens _BanterInputDialog(self.sim, self.target) on NPC click
mechanism.automatic_zone_registration: Wraps Zone.on_loading_screen_animation_finished to attach BanterPieMenuInteraction to type(sim)._super_affordances (object_sim) and instanced Sims automatically on lot load.

verified_live_behavior: On lot load with zero console commands entered, events.jsonl recorded {"type": "pie_menu_installed", "sims": 6}.
Clicking Alex Keen in live gameplay displayed "Enable English Banter" at the top-right of Page 1 of the radial Pie Menu.
Clicking "Enable English Banter" toggled _enabled=True, and clicking Alex Keen a second time displayed "Disable English Banter" in the same Pie Menu slot.
Fixed CheatOutput(_connection=None) guard in start_ai and stop so Pie-Menu execution completes cleanly without a console connection.
limits: Dynamic raw-text pie menu labels work without an STBL resource because LocalizationHelperTuning.get_raw_text wraps the string in RAW_TEXT ({0.String}).
